from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class PaperCitationRecord(BaseModel):
    """Information extracted from a single paper document regarding its citation relationships."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The title of the paper being analyzed")
    references_provided_papers: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of other provided papers that this paper references in its bibliography")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    papers: list[PaperCitationRecord]
